note_en: 起来 after an adjective or verb can mean "start to": 听完演出以后却开始好奇起来 "after the show they grew curious." Here 起来 has nothing to do with "getting up"; it marks a state that begins and grows, much like English "grow" or "become" (热起来 "get hot," 忙起来 "get busy"). 开始 and 起来 often appear together for extra emphasis, as in this sentence.
